lines.en: Wings spread, soaring high.
Gliding low, snatching prey.
Wings creating wind, skimming the water.
Waving wings, slicing the sky.
Diving for water, seeking food and eggs.
Flying over the beach, searching for fish.

lines.zh: 翅膀一斜，我沿着热气流滑。
lines.en: One wing tilt and I glide along the thermals.
Wings outstretched, surveying the land.
Gliding over the cliffs, seeking a nest.
Flying low, scanning the ground.

lines.zh: 陆地太慢，我拖着翅膀走。
lines.en: Land is slow—I drag my wings along.
Claws push off; I run to take flight.
I fly low along the coast hunting fish.
My wingtips nearly brush the waves.
Wings spread wide, resting.
Raising head, declaring territory.
Head down, waiting for prey.
Standing still, basking in the sun.
Wings half-open, resting.
Wings gently swaying, feeling the breeze.
Standing quietly, watching the world.
Head lowered, planning the attack.
Wings gently moving, enjoying the moment.
Resting quietly, waiting for flying fish.
Wings folded, I sun my back.
Perched on rock, waiting for a fish to leap.
A fish scale clings to my beak.
I turn my head slowly toward the sea.
Watching you, ready to attack.
Eyes on you, prepared.
I don't eat you. I eat fish.

lines.zh: 你站在地上，我从上面看。
lines.en: You stand on the ground; I watch from above.
Eyes ablaze, ready to attack.
Looking at you, waiting for the chance.
Fixing you, ready to strike.
Watching you, waiting to attack.
Focused on you, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 你的影子在地上，我在影上。
lines.en: Your shadow lies below; I ride above it.

lines.zh: 你的头一动，我的头也动。
lines.en: You tilt your head; I tilt mine.
Don't reach out—my beak gets there first.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了，只能在地上爬。
lines.en: Wing torn. I can only crawl.
Injured, flying back slowly!

lines.zh: 受了伤，抓紧找地方躲起来！
lines.en: Injured, hide somewhere!
Wing broken, flying slow!

lines.zh: 受伤了，我要找地方疗伤！
lines.en: Injured, healing now!

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了，现在飞不动了！
lines.en: Wings hurt, can't fly now!
Wings hurt, flying slowly back!
Injured, heal soon!
Injured, can't fly!
Wings hurt, move slowly!
The massive wingspan looms over you!

lines.zh: 鱼儿味道不错，但别太贪心。
lines.en: The fish taste good, but don't overindulge.
My pteranodon nest is far away.

lines.zh: 小心，我的幼崽需要食物。
lines.en: Watch out, my hatchlings need food.
I use fish eggs to build nests.
Stay away from my territory.
My scales protect me from harm.
I rule this sky.
My tail can fend off enemies.
Win my trust with fish meat.
Your helmet can't stop me.
Rocks can't stop me.
I won't be scared by you.
You can't break my wings.
My claws are harder than rocks.
I am clumsy on land, but I do not back down.

lines.zh: 陆上笨拙，翅膀一张就不一样。
lines.en: Clumsy on land, but not with wings open.
Rocks can't touch my scales.

lines.zh: 我的喙比任何岩石都锋利。
lines.en: My beak is sharper than any rock.
Rocks can't hurt me.
My mate is in the nest.
My call for a mate.

lines.zh: 雌性翼龙是我们的伴侣。
lines.en: Female pteranodons are our partners.
We take turns at the cliff nest.
Mate is our companion.
I call for a mate with my sound.

lines.zh: 我和我的伴侣一起筑巢。
lines.en: I build nests with my mate.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣也是我的朋友。
lines.en: My mate is also my friend.

lines.zh: 雌性翼龙帮助我养育幼崽。
lines.en: Female pteranodons help me raise hatchlings.

lines.zh: 巢筑在崖上，只等一个伴。
lines.en: My nest is on the cliff; I wait for a mate.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，我感到它的愤怒
lines.en: Rumbles angrily, I sense its wrath

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻拍动，寻找食物
lines.en: Wings flutter as it seeks food
Opens wide, ready to swallow

lines.zh: 发出低沉的嘶鸣，靠近水域
lines.en: Lets out a deep hiss, approaching the water
Bows head, dives for prey

lines.zh: 快速掠过水面，捕捉鱼类
lines.en: Races over water, snatching fish
Chews fish, savoring the meal

lines.zh: 从嘴里吐出未消化的鱼骨头
lines.en: Spits out undigested fish bones

lines.zh: 警惕地盯着我，准备攻击
lines.en: Stares intently, ready to attack
Issues warning, driving off threats

lines.zh: 我落在陆地上，走得很慢。
lines.en: On land I move slowly.
Fixes gaze, slowly approaching prey
Spreads wings, preparing to dive
Stares at ground, searching for prey
Locks on prey, locked
Aiming at prey, ready to eat
Fixes on target, preparing to strike
Fixes target, preparing to hunt
Locks on prey, preparing to chase
Fixes on enemy, ready to attack
The surface breaks—fish.
The school is just under the swell.
Something is on that rock.

lines.zh: 双翼一收，我就要扎进水里。
lines.en: Wings folded, I am about to knife into the water.
Issues warning towards target
Aiming at target, ready to eat
I've got my eye on the fish in your hand.
Fixes target, preparing to hunt
My shadow creeps closer to it.

lines.zh: 喙尖对准了水下的影子。
lines.en: My beak points at the shape underwater.
Fixes on target, preparing to strike
I fold my wings and watch the swell.
I circle aloft, waiting for a fish's back.
Fixes on target, preparing to chase

lines.zh: 风向对了，俯冲角度也算好。
lines.en: Wind is right, dive angle set.
When the fish shows, I drop.
My shadow lands on the water first.
Claws open, waiting for the strike.
I skim the crest and go straight for it.
Spread wings and dive to catch!
Growl, and grip with sharp claws.
Wings strike, no prey escapes.
Rumble, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 俯冲速度惊人，难以抵挡！
lines.en: Dive shockingly fast, hard to stop.
Sharp teeth rip, swallow prey.
Wings flap, fish fly everywhere.

lines.zh: 粗壮尾巴扫地，震慑猎物！
lines.en: Thick tail swishes, scares prey.
Wings beat, fish fall into net.
Circle low, wait for chance.
My beak clamps the fish's back and I flick.
Claws scoop the prey out of the water.
My wings slap up a sheet of spray.
The fish is still struggling in my beak.
Hatch in thunder, break shell.
Born in lightning, strong at birth.
Descend in storm, born strong.

lines.zh: 雷鸣声中现身，天降巨龙！
lines.en: Appears in thunder, heaven's dragon.
Lightning interweaves, baby hatches.
Thunder roars, newborn dragon.
Rains of storm, new birth.
Thunder calls, dragon born.
Born in storm, born a ruler.
Thunder rumbles, dragon born.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂了，湿翅膀挣出来。
lines.en: The shell splits; wet wings push out.

lines.zh: 饲养员把蛋放在暖沙上。
lines.en: The keeper set the egg in warm sand.

lines.zh: 第一声鸣叫就划破了天。
lines.en: Its first cry cuts the sky.

lines.zh: 刚破壳的小翼龙抖着身子。
lines.en: The newly hatched pteranodon shivers.

lines.zh: 骨架在石里埋了千万年。
lines.en: Its bones slept in stone for ages.
DNA put its wings back together.
Fence it tight—it can fly.

lines.zh: 一只翼龙在沙滩上试翼。
lines.en: A pteranodon tries its wings on the beach.
Fire, hurts!
Fell, wing hurt!
Water in my wings; I cannot paddle.
Explosion, wings hurt!
Hit by projectile, wing hurt!

lines.zh: 被魔法击中了，翅膀受伤！
lines.en: Hit by magic, wing hurt!
Hungry, wings hurt more!
Lightning hit, wings hurt!
Void, wings hurt!
